Everything changes when, after a grocery shopping trip leads to mutual frustration, his sharp-tongued, non-English-speaking grandma hears Dev swear at a stranger and responds in kind. title: Frankie Teardrop
overview: Frankie lies. Frankie remembers an unfortunate event from his past and how it spiralled into the state he’s in now, with a little help from an old friend.

overview: Unearthed from the ruins of a burned-down Canadian video store, this long-lost slasher is finally back to stuff your stocking - with screams.

title: Behind the Curtain
overview: A girl whose dream of acting comes before everything else. This dream requires sacrifice, effort and a heart that refuses to give up.

overview: After narrowly avoiding a car crash, a sleep deprived drifter decides to find a place to get some shuteye. overview: Maor and his younger brother Dolev live with their father in a quiet, middle-class neighborhood. On the eve of a holiday, during a game of hide-and-seek, Dolev mysteriously disappears.

title: Marion's Lilies
overview: Reeling from the murder of his wife, a man spirals into darkness and loses himself in the hunt for the killer.

overview: Immersed in a daily life where actions repeat, and hours seem to dissolve, this animated film unveils the deep pain hidden within the crushing monotony of the work routine.
